title.zh: 缺陷风险：外形合格仍要查表面
title.en: Defect risks: an acceptable shape still requires surface inspection

subtitle.zh: 损伤、腐蚀、残留与结构粘连。
subtitle.en: Damage, corrosion, residue and structural stiction

body.zh: 核心判断；几何尺寸合格不代表表面、电性和机械完整性都合格。
body.en: Core assessment Passing geometric dimensions does not mean surface, electrical and mechanical integrity all pass

body.zh: 流程位置；覆盖主刻蚀、去残留及漂洗干燥，检查隐藏损伤能否随晶圆流入下一站。
body.en: Position in the flow Cover main etch, residue removal, rinsing and drying to check whether hidden damage may travel downstream with the wafer

body.zh: 排查流程；记录缺陷；分布
body.en: Troubleshooting flow Record the defect distribution

body.zh: 区分形貌/；残留/电性异常
body.en: Distinguish profile, residue and electrical anomalies

body.zh: 对照刻蚀与；后处理条件
通过受控；验证确认原因
body.en: Confirm the cause through controlled validation

body.zh: 典型缺陷及检查方法；界面损伤；Si；缺陷检查和SEM定位
body.en: Typical defects and inspection methods Interface damage Si Defect inspection and SEM localization

body.zh: 孔底残留；Si；表面成分分析
保护层腐蚀；Si；表面成分分析
悬臂粘连；Si；缺陷检查和SEM定位
body.en: Cantilever stiction Si Defect inspection and SEM localization

body.zh: 关键控制；离子能量及充电相关条件、；化学暴露时间、后清洗强度、；漂洗干燥条件。
body.en: Key controls Ion energy and charging conditions, chemical exposure time, post-clean strength, and rinse/dry conditions

body.zh: 耦合权衡；加强清洗可能减少残留，也可能侵蚀功能膜；；降低离子能量可能减轻损伤，也可能削弱；部分表面去除能力。
body.en: Coupled trade-offs Stronger cleaning may reduce residue but also erode functional films; lower ion energy may reduce damage but also weaken some surface-removal mechanisms

body.zh: 常见失效；干法可能出现离子/充电相关损伤与聚合物残留；；湿法可能出现非目标材料腐蚀，脆弱或悬空结构；还可能在干燥时粘连。
body.en: Common failures Dry etching may cause ion/charging damage and polymer residue; wet etching may corrode nontarget materials, while fragile or suspended structures may also stick during drying

body.zh: 下游影响与边界；损伤与残留可能影响漏电、接触电阻或寿命。；湿法没有等离子体轰击，也不能因此称为“无损伤”；；干燥粘连重点针对脆弱结构，气相释放也需验证；实际工艺条件。
body.en: Downstream effects and boundaries Damage and residue may affect leakage, contact resistance or lifetime Wet etching has no plasma bombardment, but cannot therefore be called damage-free; drying stiction particularly concerns fragile structures, and vapor-phase release also requires validation under actual process conditions

body.zh: 量测反馈；先用缺陷检查和SEM定位，再按疑点选择表面成分分析或电性测试；；依据验证结果决定隔离、复测或工艺改善。
body.en: Metrology feedback First locate defects by inspection and SEM, then choose surface-composition analysis or electrical tests for the suspected issue; use validation results to decide isolation, remeasurement or process improvement
